# ECN-2026-045 - Change notice - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HT02

Reason for change
- Background: Recent process audits and metallurgical review identified variability in carbon distribution and grain coarsening trends on parts processed in Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02). Root-cause analysis referenced ECN-2026-020 and furnace maintenance records in MM-P2-L4-HT02 and found the control profile used for austenitizing was not updated to match revised load scheduling and fixture changes implemented earlier in the year.
- Issue: As-built control setpoints and documented procedure in SOP-P2-L4-04 did not reflect the optimized austenitizing setpoint determined during the metallurgical validation trials. The difference contributed to a higher incidence of post-quench hardness scatter and secondary rework events.
- Objective: Update the furnace control setpoint to the validated austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 to ensure process stability, repeatable microstructure, and reduced rework. The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 885 °C.

Affected items
- Equipment: Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) control configuration and HMI recipes. All operator screens and recipe storage for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 must be updated to reflect the new austenitizing setpoint.
- Procedures: SOP-P2-L4-04 must be revised to state the austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 as 885 °C and include the validated acceptance criteria for metallurgical checks performed post-quench. Cross-reference ECN-2026-020 for justification and trial data.
- Maintenance documentation: MM-P2-L4-HT02 preventive maintenance and calibration records must include verification of control loop performance after setpoint change. Any adjustments or repairs discovered during implementation must be recorded against MM-P2-L4-HT02.
- Production batches: All production lots run in EQ-P2-L4-HT02 after implementation will be flagged for traceability and include a note in lot records indicating they were processed under the updated setpoint. Operators will follow the updated SOP-P2-L4-04 for lot control and sampling.
- Quality hold points: Parts processed under the new setpoint will be subject to the documented sampling procedure in SOP-P2-L4-04 (as revised) until statistical confirmation of process capability is documented. See ECN-2026-020 for the metallurgical trial plan and acceptance rationale.

Implementation
- Change control actions:
  - Update furnace recipe: Modify the stored austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 to read exactly 885 °C in the control system. Save the revised recipe with change note referencing ECN-2026-045.
  - Procedure revision: Revise SOP-P2-L4-04 to reflect the austenitizing setpoint 885 °C and include step-by-step instructions for loading, thermocouple placement, and post-quench sampling aligned with the validation in ECN-2026-020.
  - Maintenance verification: Execute checks per MM-P2-L4-HT02 to confirm control loop accuracy and thermocouple integrity after recipe change. Document results in the MM-P2-L4-HT02 record.
- Execution plan:
  - Pre-change activities: Notify affected shifts and quality engineering, and place EQ-P2-L4-HT02 under controlled change status. Archive the previous recipe per document retention rules.
  - Implementation window: Implement the setpoint update during a scheduled furnace outage or controlled changeover to avoid on-going loads in process. Operators will not process production loads in EQ-P2-L4-HT02 until post-change validation is complete.
  - Post-change validation: Run the validation load plan outlined in ECN-2026-020 using the updated recipe. Collect process logs and sampling results. Perform metallographic checks and hardness testing as specified in SOP-P2-L4-04 (revised).
- Records to keep:
  - Control system printout or screenshot showing the austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 set to 885 °C, signed by the implementer and verifier.
  - MM-P2-L4-HT02 entries documenting post-change maintenance checks and any corrective actions.
  - Validation report summarizing trial loads, micrographs, hardness data, and disposition decisions; cross-reference ECN-2026-020.
  - Revised SOP-P2-L4-04 with version control reflecting incorporation of the austenitizing setpoint 885 °C.
  - Production lot records and quality hold tags for parts processed under the new setpoint until release criteria are met.
- Examples of acceptable documentation entries:
  - “Recipe EQ-P2-L4-HT02 austenitizing setpoint updated to 885 °C per ECN-2026-045. Implemented by [engineer], verified by [quality], see MM-P2-L4-HT02 for loop verification.”
  - “Validation run results: see attached report (ECN-2026-020 reference) and SOP-P2-L4-04 rev note. Lot numbers and sample IDs recorded in lot record.”

Approvals
- Engineering: Approval required from Heat Treat Engineering acknowledging that the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is set to 885 °C and that the change is consistent with metallurgical validation in ECN-2026-020.
- Maintenance: Approval required from Maintenance Supervisor per MM-P2-L4-HT02 confirming control system and sensor verification completed and documented.
- Quality: Approval required from Quality Engineering confirming SOP-P2-L4-04 revised language is acceptable and the validation sampling plan meets acceptance criteria prior to release of production lots processed under the new setpoint.
- Records of approval: Sign-off pages will be attached to ECN-2026-045, with links to MM-P2-L4-HT02 maintenance records, the validation data referenced in ECN-2026-020, and the updated SOP-P2-L4-04.

References
- ECN-2026-020
- MM-P2-L4-HT02
- SOP-P2-L4-04

End of notice.
